5. A list of strings should be inputted in the following order:
Freesia, Clarkia, Hibiscus, Gardenia, Bergenia, Erica
and inserted in a binary tree in such a way that an inorder traversal of the binary tree visits
the nodes in alphabetical order.
(a) Sketch the resulting binary tree. [3]
(b) State the number of parent nodes in this binary tree. [1]
